rooms.name: Entrance Lobby
rooms.notes: Vastu: N-facing entrance, main door to the north as per site orientation. Acts as transition from street to living area.

rooms.name: Living Room
rooms.notes: Vastu: N or E zone of floor plan. Explicit dimension 12×14 ft ≈ 15.6 sqm; north-facing for good light. Contemporary fenestration.

rooms.name: Dining Room
rooms.notes: Explicit dimension 10×10 ft ≈ 9.3 sqm. Positioned between living and kitchen for easy circulation flow.

rooms.name: Kitchen
rooms.notes: Vastu: SE corner placement as per cultural overlay. Explicit dimension 10×8 ft ≈ 7.43 sqm. MEP: gas/water connections routed to SE core.

rooms.name: Powder Room
rooms.notes: Vastu: NW or W zone placement for toilet per vastu norms. Half-bath (WC + wash basin) for ground-floor guests. MEP: wet riser from W side.

rooms.name: Pooja Room
rooms.notes: Vastu: NE corner placement as mandated. Small dedicated prayer niche; threshold raised 75 mm above floor level per tradition.

rooms.name: Front Balcony / Sit-out
rooms.notes: North-facing sit-out adjacent to living room; enhances cross-ventilation. Railing as per NBC Part 3 safety norms.

rooms.name: Covered Parking
rooms.notes: Ground-floor covered parking for one car (standard 2.5×5 m stall). Located at frontage within setback; RERA excludes from carpet area.

rooms.name: Staircase & Landing
rooms.notes: Vastu: SW or S zone placement for staircase. RCC open-riser stair connecting ground to first floor; NBC tread 250 mm, riser 190 mm, min width 1.0 m.

response.floor_summary: Ground floor of this north-facing Pune 2BHK duplex accommodates the public and semi-public programme — entrance lobby, vastu-aligned living (N), dining, SE kitchen, NE pooja room, NW powder room, front balcony, covered parking, and the RCC staircase (SW) — leaving all bedrooms and bathrooms to the first floor.
